This program is designed to run only on human cells

```{bash other_meth_scatomic}
human_data=(
  $(grep 10x-hg38 misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv \
    | cut -f 3 \
    | sort \
    | uniq \
    | grep -v Sample_ID\
  )
)

sbatch \
  --array=0-$((${#human_data[@]}-1)) \
  analysis_modules/10_cmp_other_methods/scripts/array_scatomic.sh
```
